"Ho ho hoy!
  Wonderful, wonderful!
  Young folks' dancing is wonderful!

"Such fresh dancing has me
  all fired up too! Hup hup!
  More, more! Keep dancing!

"I... I can't... I can't dance anymore...
  Somebody... somebody stop him!

"Hey! No slacking!
  This is an important dance
  for the evil god! Up, dance, dance!

"Oho! Someone's not dancing yet,
  a party pooper!
  Hup! You'll dance for me too!!
